US President Donald Trump has backed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang amid reports of an FBI probe into alleged Chinese espionage involving a woman reportedly linked to him. While Trump says Huang had no knowledge of her alleged intelligence links, China has dismissed the claims as a “groundless smear”. The controversy has raised fresh questions over AI chip security and US-China tensions.
